title: Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center The EWSC is catalyzing a new field of interdisciplinary research at the intersection of data science and life science, aimed at improving human health.
content: Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center The Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center is enabling a new field of interdisciplinary research at the intersection of the data and life sciences, aimed at improving human health. Our researchers and partners work together to make the biological questions of our time key drivers for foundational advances in machine learning — and vice versa.
